 On July 17, 2026, DHS published a final rule establishing a fixed time period of admission and an extension of stay procedure for F nonimmigrant academic students, J exchange visitors and representatives of foreign information media.
+The Broadcast Messages dated August 12, 2026 (BCM No. 2608-01), and August 24, 2026 (BCM No. 2608-02), are enjoined and stayed and should not be relied on or followed at this time due to the Court’s ruling in Ass’n. of American Univs. v. U.S. Dep’t. of Homeland Sec., No. 26-CV-14520 (D. Mass. filed Oct. 5, 2026).
 I-901 SEVIS Fee Frequently Asked Questions
 In 2004, Congress mandated all international students and exchange visitors must pay the I-901 SEVIS Fee, which funds the Student and Exchange Visitor Program (SEVP) and SEVIS. This fee is separate from visa fees and school SEVIS administration fees.
 What is the Background on the Fee Payment?

resolution.note: ICE added a notice that two broadcast messages on the July 2026 rule are blocked by a court; this matches the guide, which already says Duration of Status still applies, and the SEVIS fee information is unchanged.
